documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.text: Our partner support team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer has not identified a specific requirement or project owner, which creates operational friction in moving forward with Cedar Systems. The lack of clarity on needs and ownership is a key barrier to scheduling a discovery meeting.
